test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article for ₹19.5, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 50%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹19.5

Profit Percentage = 10%

Required Profit Percentage = 50%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit Percentage/100)

New Selling Price (SPₙₑw) = CP × (1 + Required Profit Percentage/100)

Increase in Selling Price = SPₙₑw - SP

**Calculation:**

CP = SP / (1 + Profit Percentage/100)

⇒ CP = 19.5 / (1 + 10/100)

⇒ CP = 19.5 / 1.1

⇒ CP = 17.73

SPₙₑw = CP × (1 + Required Profit Percentage/100)

⇒ SPₙₑw = 17.73 × (1 + 50/100)

⇒ SPₙₑw = 17.73 × 1.5

⇒ SPₙₑw = 26.60

Increase in Selling Price = SPₙₑw - SP

⇒ Increase = 26.60 - 19.5

⇒ Increase = 7.09

**The dealer should increase the selling price by ₹7.09 to make a profit of 50%.**
